Episodes.Title: Alleen is maar alleen
Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, Carry Goossens, An Swartenbroekx, Marijn De Valck
Episodes.Plot: Dimitri is looking for a woman through the ads in his newspaper. Xavier finds out after Dimitri played a joke on him and, along with Pico, he takes revenge on Dimitri. Xavier passes himself off as a woman and calls Dimitri.

Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, Carry Goossens, An Swartenbroekx, Marijn De Valck
Episodes.Plot: Boma organizes a tournament. Apart from the big gold, there's a trophy rewarded to the best player of the tournament. However, Boma has totally forgotten about this trophy. Things get out of hand when Boma asks Xavier to buy a new trophy.

Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, Carry Goossens, An Swartenbroekx
Episodes.Plot: Bieke came home early from the United States. She instantly looks for a job and a decent car. She goes to work at Publitime, a news magazine. Meanwhile, Dimitri has purchased an overpriced car. He wants to sell the car to Bieke.
